scope: Only success-trace gating runtime diff and its compiled regression test, not unrelated historical code or device performance.

result.summary: The diff gates verbose success-path diagnostics behind a cached WOL_DRAW_TRACE opt-in while preserving unconditional error reporting via glGetError() checks. The gating is applied consistently to WOL_CAT_DRAW, WOL_PAIR_BANK, WOL_PAIR_TEX, WOL_PAIR_DRAW, WOL_PROGRAM_BOUND, and WOL_DOWNSAMPLE_BLIT. The new wol_draw_trace_enabled() helper uses atomic compare-exchange to cache the env lookup, and the glGetError() call is correctly hoisted out of the printf arguments so error queries still occur when tracing is disabled. The accompanying test correctly verifies the policy, error preservation, and query counts.
